records.title: Prunus domestica (European Plum)
records.institution: North Carolina State University Extension Gardener
records.excerpt: in Turkey and Europe, but is now only grown in cultivation. This plant typically grows as a large shrub or small tree up to 10-20 feet tall. It is a deciduous tree with showy white flowers and edible purple stone fruits. It may have some spines. Greengage and damson plums are subspecies of P. domes
